##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ActivityLog)ActivityLog
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ActivityLog/operation/GetLogEntries)Gets activity log entries.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
minDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum date. Format = ISO.
hasUserId |  boolean Optional. Filter log entries if it has user id, or not.
### Responses
**200**
Activity log returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/System/ActivityLog/Entries
http://localhost/System/ActivityLog/Entries

  * 200

application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json

  }
 ],

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Artists)Artists
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Artists/operation/GetArtists)Gets all artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
minCommunityRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum community rating.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
searchTerm |  string Optional. Search term.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
genres |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
genreIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
officialRatings |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
tags |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
years |  Array of integers <int32> [ items <int32 > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
person |  string Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.
personIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.
personTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
studios |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
studioIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Artists returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Artists/operation/GetArtistByName)Gets an artist by name.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
namerequired |  string Studio name.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---

**200**
Artist returned.
**401**

**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Artists/operation/GetAlbumArtists)Gets all album artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
minCommunityRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum community rating.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
searchTerm |  string Optional. Search term.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
genres |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
genreIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
officialRatings |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
tags |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
years |  Array of integers <int32> [ items <int32 > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
person |  string Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.
personIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.
personTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
studios |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
studioIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Album artists returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

http://localhost/Artists/AlbumArtists

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Audio)Audio
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Audio/operation/GetAudioStream)Gets an audio stream.
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
container |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The audio container.
---|---
static |  boolean Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.
params |  string The streaming parameters.
tag |  string The tag.
deviceProfileId |  string Deprecated  Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.
playSessionId |  string The play session id.
segmentContainer |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The segment container.
segmentLength |  integer <int32> The segment length.
minSegments |  integer <int32> The minimum number of segments.
mediaSourceId |  string The media version id, if playing an alternate version.
deviceId |  string The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.
audioCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.
enableAutoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.
allowVideoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.
allowAudioStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.
breakOnNonKeyFrames |  boolean Optional. Whether to break on non key frames.
audioSampleRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.
maxAudioBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.
audioBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
audioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.
maxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.
profile |  string Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.
level |  string-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)? Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.
framerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
maxFramerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
copyTimestamps |  boolean Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.
startTimeTicks |  integer <int64> Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.
width |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.
height |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.
videoBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
subtitleStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.
subtitleMethod |  string Enum: "Encode" "Embed" "External" "Hls" "Drop" Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.
maxRefFrames |  integer <int32> Optional.
maxVideoBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum video bit depth.
requireAvc |  boolean Optional. Whether to require avc.
deInterlace |  boolean Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.
requireNonAnamorphic |  boolean Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.
transcodingMaxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.
cpuCoreLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.
liveStreamId |  string The live stream id.
enableMpegtsM2TsMode |  boolean Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.
videoCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.
subtitleCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a subtitle codec to encode to.
transcodeReasons |  string Optional. The transcoding reason.
audioStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.
videoStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.
context |  string Enum: "Streaming" "Static" Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.
streamOptions |  object Optional. The streaming options.
enableAudioVbrEncoding |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Whether to enable Audio Encoding.
### Responses
**200**
Audio stream returned.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Audio/{itemId}/stream
http://localhost/Audio/{itemId}/stream

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Channels/operation/GetChannelItems)Get channel items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
channelIdrequired |  string <uuid> Channel Id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
folderId |  string <uuid> Optional. Folder Id.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. User Id.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Optional. Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Channels/operation/GetLatestChannelItems)Gets latest channel items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. User Id.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
channelIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. Specify one or more channel id's, comma delimited.
### Responses
**200**
Latest channel items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Channels/Items/Latest
http://localhost/Channels/Items/Latest

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ClientLog)ClientLog
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ClientLog/operation/LogFile)Upload a document.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema: text/plain
string <binary>
### Responses
**200**
Document saved.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Event logging disabled.
**413**
Upload size too large.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/ClientLog/Document
http://localhost/ClientLog/Document
###  Response samples
  * 200
  * 403
  * 413


Content type
application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json
Copy
`{
  *  "FileName": "string"

 }`
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Collection)Collection
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Collection/operation/CreateCollection)Creates a new collection.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
name |  string The name of the collection.
---|---
ids |  Array of strings Item Ids to add to the collection.
parentId |  string <uuid> Optional. Create the collection within a specific folder.
isLocked |  boolean Default:  false Whether or not to lock the new collection.
### Responses
**200**
Collection created.

Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden

The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Configuration/operation/UpdateConfiguration)Updates application configuration.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
Configuration.
LogFileRetentionDays |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the number of days we should retain log files.
---|---
IsStartupWizardCompleted |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is first run.
CachePath |  string or null Gets or sets the cache path.
PreviousVersion |  string or null Gets or sets the last known version that was ran using the configuration.
PreviousVersionStr |  string or null Gets or sets the stringified PreviousVersion to be stored/loaded, because System.Version itself isn't xml-serializable.
EnableMetrics |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable prometheus metrics exporting.
EnableNormalizedItemByNameIds |  boolean
IsPortAuthorized |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is port authorized.
QuickConnectAvailable |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether quick connect is available for use on this server.
EnableCaseSensitiveItemIds |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether [enable case-sensitive item ids].
DisableLiveTvChannelUserDataName |  boolean
MetadataPath |  string Gets or sets the metadata path.
PreferredMetadataLanguage |  string Gets or sets the preferred metadata language.
MetadataCountryCode |  string Gets or sets the metadata country code.
SortReplaceCharacters |  Array of strings Gets or sets characters to be replaced with a ' ' in strings to create a sort name.
SortRemoveCharacters |  Array of strings Gets or sets characters to be removed from strings to create a sort name.
SortRemoveWords |  Array of strings Gets or sets words to be removed from strings to create a sort name.
MinResumePct |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the minimum percentage of an item that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.
MaxResumePct |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the maximum percentage of an item that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.
MinResumeDurationSeconds |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the minimum duration that an item must have in order to be eligible for playstate updates..
MinAudiobookResume |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the minimum minutes of a book that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.
MaxAudiobookResume |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the remaining minutes of a book that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.
InactiveSessionThreshold |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the threshold in minutes after a inactive session gets closed automatically. If set to 0 the check for inactive sessions gets disabled.
LibraryMonitorDelay |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the delay in seconds that we will wait after a file system change to try and discover what has been added/removed Some delay is necessary with some items because their creation is not atomic. It involves the creation of several different directories and files.
LibraryUpdateDuration |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the duration in seconds that we will wait after a library updated event before executing the library changed notification.
CacheSize |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the maximum amount of items to cache.
ImageSavingConvention |  string Enum: "Legacy" "Compatible" Gets or sets the image saving convention.
MetadataOptions |  Array of objects (MetadataOptions)
SkipDeserializationForBasicTypes |  boolean
ServerName |  string
UICulture |  string
SaveMetadataHidden |  boolean
ContentTypes |  Array of objects (NameValuePair)
RemoteClientBitrateLimit |  integer <int32>
EnableFolderView |  boolean
EnableGroupingMoviesIntoCollections |  boolean
EnableGroupingShowsIntoCollections |  boolean
DisplaySpecialsWithinSeasons |  boolean
CodecsUsed |  Array of strings
PluginRepositories |  Array of objects (RepositoryInfo)
EnableExternalContentInSuggestions |  boolean
ImageExtractionTimeoutMs |  integer <int32>
PathSubstitutions |  Array of objects (PathSubstitution)
EnableSlowResponseWarning |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether slow server responses should be logged as a warning.
SlowResponseThresholdMs |  integer <int64> Gets or sets the threshold for the slow response time warning in ms.

##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
playlistIdrequired |  string The playlist id.
segmentIdrequired |  integer <int32> The segment id.
containerrequired |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The video container. Possible values are: ts, webm, asf, wmv, ogv, mp4, m4v, mkv, mpeg, mpg, avi, 3gp, wmv, wtv, m2ts, mov, iso, flv.
##### query Parameters
runtimeTicksrequired |  integer <int64> The position of the requested segment in ticks.
---|---
actualSegmentLengthTicksrequired |  integer <int64> The length of the requested segment in ticks.
static |  boolean Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.
params |  string The streaming parameters.
tag |  string The tag.
deviceProfileId |  string Deprecated  Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.
playSessionId |  string The play session id.
segmentContainer |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The segment container.
segmentLength |  integer <int32> The segment length.
minSegments |  integer <int32> The minimum number of segments.
mediaSourceId |  string The media version id, if playing an alternate version.
deviceId |  string The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.
audioCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3.
enableAutoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.
allowVideoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.
allowAudioStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.
breakOnNonKeyFrames |  boolean Optional. Whether to break on non key frames.
audioSampleRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.
maxAudioBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.
maxStreamingBitrate |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum streaming bitrate.
audioBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
audioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.
maxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.
profile |  string Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.
level |  string-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)? Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.
framerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
maxFramerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
copyTimestamps |  boolean Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.
startTimeTicks |  integer <int64> Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.
width |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.
height |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.
videoBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
subtitleStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.
subtitleMethod |  string Enum: "Encode" "Embed" "External" "Hls" "Drop" Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.
maxRefFrames |  integer <int32> Optional.
maxVideoBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum video bit depth.
requireAvc |  boolean Optional. Whether to require avc.
deInterlace |  boolean Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.
requireNonAnamorphic |  boolean Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.
transcodingMaxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.
cpuCoreLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.
liveStreamId |  string The live stream id.
enableMpegtsM2TsMode |  boolean Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.
videoCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264.
subtitleCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a subtitle codec to encode to.
transcodeReasons |  string Optional. The transcoding reason.
audioStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.
videoStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.
context |  string Enum: "Streaming" "Static" Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.
streamOptions |  object Optional. The streaming options.
enableAudioVbrEncoding |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Whether to enable Audio Encoding.
### Responses
**200**
Video stream returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Audio/{itemId}/hls1/{playlistId}/{segmentId}.{container}
http://localhost/Audio/{itemId}/hls1/{playlistId}/{segmentId}.{container}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Genres/operation/GetGenres)Gets all genres from a given item, folder, or the entire library.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_

---|---

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/HlsSegment)HlsSegment
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/HlsSegment/operation/GetHlsAudioSegmentLegacyAac)Gets the specified audio segment for an audio item.
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string The item id.
---|---
segmentIdrequired |  string The segment id.
### Responses
**200**
Hls audio segment returned.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Audio/{itemId}/hls/{segmentId}/stream.aac
http://localhost/Audio/{itemId}/hls/{segmentId}/stream.aac
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/HlsSegment/operation/GetHlsAudioSegmentLegacyMp3)Gets the specified audio segment for an audio item.
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string The item id.
---|---
segmentIdrequired |  string The segment id.
### Responses
**200**
Hls audio segment returned.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Audio/{itemId}/hls/{segmentId}/stream.mp3
http://localhost/Audio/{itemId}/hls/{segmentId}/stream.mp3
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/HlsSegment/operation/GetHlsVideoSegmentLegacy)Gets a hls video segment.
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string The item id.
---|---
playlistIdrequired |  string The playlist id.
segmentIdrequired |  string The segment id.
segmentContainerrequired |  string The segment container.
### Responses
**200**
Hls video segment returned.
**404**
Hls segment not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Videos/{itemId}/hls/{playlistId}/{segmentId}.{segmentContainer}
http://localhost/Videos/{itemId}/hls/{playlistId}/{segmentId}.{segmentContainer}

maxHeight |  integer <int32> The maximum image height to return.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/InstantMix/operation/GetInstantMixFromArtists)Creates an instant playlist based on a given artist.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Instant playlist returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Artists/{itemId}/InstantMix
http://localhost/Artists/{itemId}/InstantMix

  * 404

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/InstantMix/operation/GetInstantMixFromArtists2)Creates an instant playlist based on a given artist.  Deprecated
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
idrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Instant playlist returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/InstantMix/operation/GetInstantMixFromItem)Creates an instant playlist based on a given item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Instant playlist returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/InstantMix
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/InstantMix

  * 404

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/InstantMix/operation/GetInstantMixFromMusicGenreByName)Creates an instant playlist based on a given genre.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
namerequired |  string The genre name.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Instant playlist returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/InstantMix/operation/GetInstantMixFromSong)Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Instant playlist returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Songs/{itemId}/InstantMix
http://localhost/Songs/{itemId}/InstantMix

  * 404

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ItemRefresh)ItemRefresh
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/ItemRefresh/operation/RefreshItem)Refreshes metadata for an item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> Item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
metadataRefreshMode |  string Default:  "None" Enum: "None" "ValidationOnly" "Default" "FullRefresh" (Optional) Specifies the metadata refresh mode.
---|---
imageRefreshMode |  string Default:  "None" Enum: "None" "ValidationOnly" "Default" "FullRefresh" (Optional) Specifies the image refresh mode.
replaceAllMetadata |  boolean Default:  false (Optional) Determines if metadata should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.
replaceAllImages |  boolean Default:  false (Optional) Determines if images should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.
regenerateTrickplay |  boolean Default:  false (Optional) Determines if trickplay images should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.
### Responses
**204**
Item metadata refresh queued.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item to refresh not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Items)Items
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Items/operation/GetItems)Gets items based on a query.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id supplied as query parameter; this is required when not using an API key.
---|---
maxOfficialRating |  string Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).
hasThemeSong |  boolean Optional filter by items with theme songs.
hasThemeVideo |  boolean Optional filter by items with theme videos.
hasSubtitles |  boolean Optional filter by items with subtitles.
hasSpecialFeature |  boolean Optional filter by items with special features.
hasTrailer |  boolean Optional filter by items with trailers.
adjacentTo |  string <uuid> Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.
indexNumber |  integer <int32> Optional filter by index number.
parentIndexNumber |  integer <int32> Optional filter by parent index number.
hasParentalRating |  boolean Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.
isHd |  boolean Optional filter by items that are HD or not.
is4K |  boolean Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.
locationTypes |  Array of strings (LocationType)  Items Enum: "FileSystem" "Remote" "Virtual" "Offline" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
excludeLocationTypes |  Array of strings (LocationType)  Items Enum: "FileSystem" "Remote" "Virtual" "Offline" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
isMissing |  boolean Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.
isUnaired |  boolean Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.
minCommunityRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum community rating.
minCriticRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum critic rating.
minPremiereDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.
minDateLastSaved |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.
minDateLastSavedForUser |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.
maxPremiereDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.
hasOverview |  boolean Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.
hasImdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have an IMDb id or not.
hasTmdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have a TMDb id or not.
hasTvdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have a TVDb id or not.
isMovie |  boolean Optional filter for live tv movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional filter for live tv series.
isNews |  boolean Optional filter for live tv news.
isKids |  boolean Optional filter for live tv kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional filter for live tv sports.
excludeItemIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
recursive |  boolean When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.
searchTerm |  string Optional. Filter based on a search term.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
imageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
isPlayed |  boolean Optional filter by items that are played, or not.
genres |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
officialRatings |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
tags |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
years |  Array of integers <int32> [ items <int32 > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
person |  string Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.
personIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.
personTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
studios |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
artists |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
artistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.
albumArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.
contributingArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.
albums |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
albumIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
ids |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
videoTypes |  Array of strings (VideoType)  Items Enum: "VideoFile" "Iso" "Dvd" "BluRay" Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.
minOfficialRating |  string Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).
isLocked |  boolean Optional filter by items that are locked.
isPlaceHolder |  boolean Optional filter by items that are placeholders.
hasOfficialRating |  boolean Optional filter by items that have official ratings.
collapseBoxSetItems |  boolean Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.
minWidth |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.
minHeight |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.
maxWidth |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.
maxHeight |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.
is3D |  boolean Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.
seriesStatus |  Array of strings (SeriesStatus)  Items Enum: "Continuing" "Ended" "Unreleased" Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
studioIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
genreIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Enable the total record count.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Items/operation/UpdateItemUserData)Update Item User Data.

_CustomAuthentication_

---|---

application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
New user data object.
Rating |  number or null <double> Gets or sets the rating.
---|---
PlayedPercentage |  number or null <double> Gets or sets the played percentage.
UnplayedItemCount |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the unplayed item count.
PlaybackPositionTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the playback position ticks.
PlayCount |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the play count.
IsFavorite |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is favorite.
Likes |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether this MediaBrowser.Model.Dto.UpdateUserItemDataDto is likes.
LastPlayedDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the last played date.
Played |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether this MediaBrowser.Model.Dto.UserItemDataDto is played.
Key |  string or null Gets or sets the key.
ItemId |  string or null Gets or sets the item identifier.
### Responses
**200**
return updated user item data.
**401**

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Items/operation/GetResumeItems)Gets items based on a query.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> The start index.
limit |  integer <int32> The item limit.
searchTerm |  string The search term.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional. Filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Enable the total record count.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Include image information in output.
excludeActiveSessions |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Whether to exclude the currently active sessions.
### Responses
**200**
Items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/DeleteItems)Deletes items from the library and filesystem.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
ids |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] The item ids.
---|---
### Responses
**204**
Items deleted.
**401**
Unauthorized access.
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Not Found
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
delete/Items
http://localhost/Items

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetSimilarAlbums)Gets similar items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Exclude artist ids.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
### Responses
**200**
Similar items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Albums/{itemId}/Similar
http://localhost/Albums/{itemId}/Similar

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetSimilarArtists)Gets similar items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Exclude artist ids.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
### Responses
**200**
Similar items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Artists/{itemId}/Similar
http://localhost/Artists/{itemId}/Similar

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetAncestors)Gets all parents of an item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Item parents returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/Ancestors
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/Ancestors

  * 404

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetThemeMedia)Get theme songs and videos for an item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
inheritFromParent |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.
### Responses
**200**
Theme songs and videos returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/ThemeMedia
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/ThemeMedia
###  Response samples
  * 200


Content type
application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetThemeSongs)Get theme songs for an item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
inheritFromParent |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.
### Responses
**200**
Theme songs returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/ThemeSongs
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/ThemeSongs
###  Response samples
  * 200
  * 404


Content type
application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetThemeVideos)Get theme videos for an item.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
inheritFromParent |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.
### Responses
**200**
Theme videos returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/ThemeVideos
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/ThemeVideos
###  Response samples
  * 200
  * 404

application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetSimilarMovies)Gets similar items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Exclude artist ids.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
### Responses
**200**
Similar items returned.

Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
