##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetSimilarShows)Gets similar items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Exclude artist ids.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
### Responses
**200**
Similar items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Shows/{itemId}/Similar
http://localhost/Shows/{itemId}/Similar

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Library/operation/GetSimilarTrailers)Gets similar items.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Exclude artist ids.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
### Responses
**200**
Similar items returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Trailers/{itemId}/Similar
http://localhost/Trailers/{itemId}/Similar

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/UserLibrary/operation/GetIntros)Gets intros to play before the main media item plays.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> Item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Intros returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/{itemId}/Intros
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/Intros

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/UserLibrary/operation/GetLatestMedia)Gets latest media.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
---|---
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
isPlayed |  boolean Filter by items that are played, or not.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. include user data.
limit |  integer <int32> Default:  20 Return item limit.
groupItems |  boolean Default:  true Whether or not to group items into a parent container.
### Responses
**200**
Latest media returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Items/Latest
http://localhost/Items/Latest

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/UserLibrary/operation/GetRootFolder)Gets the root folder from a user's library.

_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
---|---
### Responses
**200**

**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetLiveTvChannels)Gets available live tv channels.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
type |  string Enum: "TV" "Radio" Optional. Filter by channel type.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
isMovie |  boolean Optional. Filter for movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional. Filter for series.
isNews |  boolean Optional. Filter for news.
isKids |  boolean Optional. Filter for kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional. Filter for sports.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional. Filter by channels that are favorites, or not.
isLiked |  boolean Optional. Filter by channels that are liked, or not.
isDisliked |  boolean Optional. Filter by channels that are disliked, or not.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" "Optional. The image types to include in the output.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Key to sort by.
sortOrder |  string Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Optional. Sort order.
enableFavoriteSorting |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Incorporate favorite and like status into channel sorting.
addCurrentProgram |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Adds current program info to each channel.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetChannel)Gets a live tv channel.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
channelIdrequired |  string <uuid> Channel id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Live tv channel returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/LiveTv/Channels/{channelId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Channels/{channelId}

  * 404

channelIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] The channels to return guide information for.

hasAired |  boolean Optional. Filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.

maxStartDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The maximum premiere start date.
minEndDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum premiere end date.
maxEndDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The maximum premiere end date.
isMovie |  boolean Optional. Filter for movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional. Filter for series.
isNews |  boolean Optional. Filter for news.
isKids |  boolean Optional. Filter for kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional. Filter for sports.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. genres |  Array of strings The genres to return guide information for.

enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetPrograms)Gets available live tv epgs.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
Request body.
ChannelIds |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Gets or sets the channels to return guide information for.
---|---
UserId |  string or null <uuid> Gets or sets optional. Filter by user id.
MinStartDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the minimum premiere start date.
HasAired |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.
IsAiring |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.
MaxStartDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the maximum premiere start date.
MinEndDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the minimum premiere end date.
MaxEndDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the maximum premiere end date.
IsMovie |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter for movies.
IsSeries |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter for series.
IsNews |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter for news.
IsKids |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter for kids.
IsSports |  boolean or null Gets or sets filter for sports.
StartIndex |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
Limit |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the maximum number of records to return.
SortBy |  Array of strings or null (ItemSortBy)  Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Gets or sets specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Name, StartDate.
SortOrder |  Array of strings or null (SortOrder)  Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Gets or sets sort order.
Genres |  Array of strings or null Gets or sets the genres to return guide information for.
GenreIds |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Gets or sets the genre ids to return guide information for.
EnableImages |  boolean or null Gets or sets include image information in output.
EnableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Gets or sets a value indicating whether retrieve total record count.
ImageTypeLimit |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the max number of images to return, per image type.
EnableImageTypes |  Array of strings or null (ImageType)  Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Gets or sets the image types to include in the output.
EnableUserData |  boolean or null Gets or sets include user data.
SeriesTimerId |  string or null Gets or sets filter by series timer id.
LibrarySeriesId |  string or null <uuid> Gets or sets filter by library series id.
Fields |  Array of strings or null (ItemFields)  Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Gets or sets specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
### Responses
**200**
Live tv epgs returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/LiveTv/Programs
http://localhost/LiveTv/Programs

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetProgram)Gets a live tv program.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
programIdrequired |  string Program id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Program returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/LiveTv/Programs/{programId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Programs/{programId}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetRecommendedPrograms)Gets recommended live tv epgs.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. filter by user id.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
isAiring |  boolean Optional. Filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.
hasAired |  boolean Optional. Filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.
isSeries |  boolean Optional. Filter for series.
isMovie |  boolean Optional. Filter for movies.
isNews |  boolean Optional. Filter for news.
isKids |  boolean Optional. Filter for kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional. Filter for sports.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
genreIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] The genres to return guide information for.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. include user data.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Retrieve total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Recommended epgs returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/LiveTv/Programs/Recommended
http://localhost/LiveTv/Programs/Recommended

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetRecordings)Gets live tv recordings.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
channelId |  string Optional. Filter by channel id.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
status |  string Enum: "New" "InProgress" "Completed" "Cancelled" "ConflictedOk" "ConflictedNotOk" "Error" Optional. Filter by recording status.
isInProgress |  boolean Optional. Filter by recordings that are in progress, or not.
seriesTimerId |  string Optional. Filter by recordings belonging to a series timer.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
isMovie |  boolean Optional. Filter for movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional. Filter for series.
isKids |  boolean Optional. Filter for kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional. Filter for sports.
isNews |  boolean Optional. Filter for news.
isLibraryItem |  boolean Optional. Filter for is library item.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Return total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Live tv recordings returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/LiveTv/Recordings
http://localhost/LiveTv/Recordings

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetRecording)Gets a live tv recording.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
recordingIdrequired |  string <uuid> Recording id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Recording returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}

  * 404

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/DeleteRecording)Deletes a live tv recording.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
recordingIdrequired |  string <uuid> Recording id.
---|---
### Responses
**204**
Recording deleted.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
delete/LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/GetRecordingsSeries)Gets live tv recording series.  Deprecated
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
channelId |  string Optional. Filter by channel id.
---|---
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.
groupId |  string Optional. Filter by recording group.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
status |  string Enum: "New" "InProgress" "Completed" "Cancelled" "ConflictedOk" "ConflictedNotOk" "Error" Optional. Filter by recording status.
isInProgress |  boolean Optional. Filter by recordings that are in progress, or not.
seriesTimerId |  string Optional. Filter by recordings belonging to a series timer.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Return total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Live tv recordings returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/CreateTimer)Creates a live tv timer.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
New timer info.
Id |  string or null Gets or sets the Id of the recording.
---|---
Type |  string or null
ServerId |  string or null Gets or sets the server identifier.
ExternalId |  string or null Gets or sets the external identifier.
ChannelId |  string <uuid> Gets or sets the channel id of the recording.
ExternalChannelId |  string or null Gets or sets the external channel identifier.
ChannelName |  string or null Gets or sets the channel name of the recording.
ChannelPrimaryImageTag |  string or null
ProgramId |  string or null Gets or sets the program identifier.
ExternalProgramId |  string or null Gets or sets the external program identifier.
Name |  string or null Gets or sets the name of the recording.
Overview |  string or null Gets or sets the description of the recording.
StartDate |  string <date-time> Gets or sets the start date of the recording, in UTC.
EndDate |  string <date-time> Gets or sets the end date of the recording, in UTC.
ServiceName |  string or null Gets or sets the name of the service.
Priority |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the priority.
PrePaddingSeconds |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.
PostPaddingSeconds |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the post padding seconds.
IsPrePaddingRequired |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is pre padding required.
ParentBackdropItemId |  string or null Gets or sets the Id of the Parent that has a backdrop if the item does not have one.
ParentBackdropImageTags |  Array of strings or null Gets or sets the parent backdrop image tags.
IsPostPaddingRequired |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is post padding required.
KeepUntil |  string Enum: "UntilDeleted" "UntilSpaceNeeded" "UntilWatched" "UntilDate"
Status |  string Enum: "New" "InProgress" "Completed" "Cancelled" "ConflictedOk" "ConflictedNotOk" "Error" Gets or sets the status.
SeriesTimerId |  string or null Gets or sets the series timer identifier.
ExternalSeriesTimerId |  string or null Gets or sets the external series timer identifier.
RunTimeTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the run time ticks.
ProgramInfo |  object or null Gets or sets the program information.
### Responses
**204**
Timer created.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/LiveTv/Timers
http://localhost/LiveTv/Timers

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/CancelTimer)Cancels a live tv timer.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
timerIdrequired |  string Timer id.
---|---
### Responses
**204**
Timer deleted.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
delete/LiveTv/Timers/{timerId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Timers/{timerId}
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/LiveTv/operation/UpdateTimer)Updates a live tv timer.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
timerIdrequired |  string Timer id.
---|---
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
New timer info.
Id |  string or null Gets or sets the Id of the recording.
---|---
Type |  string or null
ServerId |  string or null Gets or sets the server identifier.
ExternalId |  string or null Gets or sets the external identifier.
ChannelId |  string <uuid> Gets or sets the channel id of the recording.
ExternalChannelId |  string or null Gets or sets the external channel identifier.
ChannelName |  string or null Gets or sets the channel name of the recording.
ChannelPrimaryImageTag |  string or null
ProgramId |  string or null Gets or sets the program identifier.
ExternalProgramId |  string or null Gets or sets the external program identifier.
Name |  string or null Gets or sets the name of the recording.
Overview |  string or null Gets or sets the description of the recording.
StartDate |  string <date-time> Gets or sets the start date of the recording, in UTC.
EndDate |  string <date-time> Gets or sets the end date of the recording, in UTC.
ServiceName |  string or null Gets or sets the name of the service.
Priority |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the priority.
PrePaddingSeconds |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.
PostPaddingSeconds |  integer <int32> Gets or sets the post padding seconds.
IsPrePaddingRequired |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is pre padding required.
ParentBackdropItemId |  string or null Gets or sets the Id of the Parent that has a backdrop if the item does not have one.
ParentBackdropImageTags |  Array of strings or null Gets or sets the parent backdrop image tags.
IsPostPaddingRequired |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is post padding required.
KeepUntil |  string Enum: "UntilDeleted" "UntilSpaceNeeded" "UntilWatched" "UntilDate"
Status |  string Enum: "New" "InProgress" "Completed" "Cancelled" "ConflictedOk" "ConflictedNotOk" "Error" Gets or sets the status.
SeriesTimerId |  string or null Gets or sets the series timer identifier.
ExternalSeriesTimerId |  string or null Gets or sets the external series timer identifier.
RunTimeTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the run time ticks.
ProgramInfo |  object or null Gets or sets the program information.
### Responses
**204**
Timer updated.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/LiveTv/Timers/{timerId}
http://localhost/LiveTv/Timers/{timerId}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MediaInfo/operation/GetPostedPlaybackInfo)Gets live playback media info for an item.
For backwards compatibility parameters can be sent via Query or Body, with Query having higher precedence. Query parameters are obsolete.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Deprecated  The user id.
---|---
maxStreamingBitrate |  integer <int32> Deprecated  The maximum streaming bitrate.
startTimeTicks |  integer <int64> Deprecated  The start time in ticks.
audioStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Deprecated  The audio stream index.
subtitleStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Deprecated  The subtitle stream index.
maxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Deprecated  The maximum number of audio channels.
mediaSourceId |  string Deprecated  The media source id.
liveStreamId |  string Deprecated  The livestream id.
autoOpenLiveStream |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to auto open the livestream.
enableDirectPlay |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to enable direct play. Default: true.
enableDirectStream |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to enable direct stream. Default: true.
enableTranscoding |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to enable transcoding. Default: true.
allowVideoStreamCopy |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to allow to copy the video stream. Default: true.
allowAudioStreamCopy |  boolean Deprecated  Whether to allow to copy the audio stream. Default: true.
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
The playback info.
UserId |  string or null <uuid> Gets or sets the playback userId.
---|---
MaxStreamingBitrate |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the max streaming bitrate.
StartTimeTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the start time in ticks.
AudioStreamIndex |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the audio stream index.
SubtitleStreamIndex |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the subtitle stream index.
MaxAudioChannels |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the max audio channels.
MediaSourceId |  string or null Gets or sets the media source id.
LiveStreamId |  string or null Gets or sets the live stream id.
DeviceProfile |  object or null A MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile represents a set of metadata which determines which content a certain device is able to play.
Specifically, it defines the supported containers and codecs (video and/or audio, including codec profiles and levels) the device is able to direct play (without transcoding or remuxing), as well as which containers/codecs to transcode to in case it isn't.
EnableDirectPlay |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct play.
EnableDirectStream |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct stream.
EnableTranscoding |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable transcoding.
AllowVideoStreamCopy |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable video stream copy.
AllowAudioStreamCopy |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to allow audio stream copy.
AutoOpenLiveStream |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether to auto open the live stream.
AlwaysBurnInSubtitleWhenTranscoding |  boolean or null Gets or sets a value indicating whether always burn in subtitles when transcoding.
### Responses
**200**
Playback info returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo
http://localhost/Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MediaInfo/operation/GetBitrateTestBytes)Tests the network with a request with the size of the bitrate.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
size |  integer <int32> [ 1 .. 100000000 ]  Default:  102400 The bitrate. Defaults to 102400.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Test buffer returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Playback/BitrateTest
http://localhost/Playback/BitrateTest
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MediaSegments)MediaSegments
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MediaSegments/operation/GetItemSegments)Gets all media segments based on an itemId.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The ItemId.
---|---
##### query Parameters
includeSegmentTypes |  Array of strings (MediaSegmentType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Commercial" "Preview" "Recap" "Outro" "Intro" Optional filter of requested segment types.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Not Found
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/MediaSegments/{itemId}
http://localhost/MediaSegments/{itemId}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Movies)Movies
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Movies/operation/GetMovieRecommendations)Gets movie recommendations.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. The fields to return.
categoryLimit |  integer <int32> Default:  5 The max number of categories to return.
itemLimit |  integer <int32> Default:  8 The max number of items to return per category.
### Responses
**200**
Movie recommendations returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Movies/Recommendations
http://localhost/Movies/Recommendations

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MusicGenres)MusicGenres
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MusicGenres/operation/GetMusicGenres)Gets all music genres from a given item, folder, or the entire library.  Deprecated
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
searchTerm |  string The search term.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered in based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Include total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Music genres returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/MusicGenres/operation/GetMusicGenre)Gets a music genre, by name.

_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
genreNamerequired |  string The genre name.
---|---
##### query Parameters

---|---

**401**

**403**

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Persons)Persons
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Persons/operation/GetPersons)Gets all persons.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
---|---
searchTerm |  string The search term.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not. userId is required.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
excludePersonTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified results will be filtered to exclude those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
personTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
appearsInItemId |  string <uuid> Optional. If specified, person results will be filtered on items related to said persons.
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
### Responses
**200**
Persons returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Persons/operation/GetPerson)Get person by name.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
namerequired |  string Person name.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Person returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Person not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

http://localhost/Persons/{name}

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Playlists/operation/CreatePlaylist)Creates a new playlist.
For backwards compatibility parameters can be sent via Query or Body, with Query having higher precedence. Query parameters are obsolete.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
name |  string Deprecated  The playlist name.
---|---
ids |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Deprecated  The item ids.
userId |  string <uuid> Deprecated  The user id.
mediaType |  string Deprecated  Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" The media type.
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
The create playlist payload.
Name |  string Gets or sets the name of the new playlist.
---|---
Ids |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Gets or sets item ids to add to the playlist.
UserId |  string or null <uuid> Gets or sets the user id.
MediaType |  string or null Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Gets or sets the media type.
Users |  Array of objects (PlaylistUserPermissions)  Gets or sets the playlist users.
IsPublic |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether the playlist is public.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Playstate/operation/PingPlaybackSession)Pings a playback session.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
playSessionIdrequired |  string Playback session id.
---|---
### Responses
**204**
Playback session pinged.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Sessions/Playing/Ping
http://localhost/Sessions/Playing/Ping
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Playstate/operation/ReportPlaybackProgress)Reports playback progress within a session.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
The playback progress info.
CanSeek |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance can seek.
---|---
Item |  object or null Gets or sets the item.
ItemId |  string <uuid> Gets or sets the item identifier.
SessionId |  string or null Gets or sets the session id.
MediaSourceId |  string or null Gets or sets the media version identifier.
AudioStreamIndex |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the index of the audio stream.
SubtitleStreamIndex |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the index of the subtitle stream.
IsPaused |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is paused.
IsMuted |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is muted.
PositionTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the position ticks.
PlaybackStartTimeTicks |  integer or null <int64>
VolumeLevel |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the volume level.
Brightness |  integer or null <int32>
AspectRatio |  string or null
PlayMethod |  string Enum: "Transcode" "DirectStream" "DirectPlay" Gets or sets the play method.
LiveStreamId |  string or null Gets or sets the live stream identifier.
PlaySessionId |  string or null Gets or sets the play session identifier.
RepeatMode |  string Enum: "RepeatNone" "RepeatAll" "RepeatOne" Gets or sets the repeat mode.
PlaybackOrder |  string Enum: "Default" "Shuffle" Gets or sets the playback order.
NowPlayingQueue |  Array of objects or null (QueueItem)
PlaylistItemId |  string or null
### Responses
**204**
Playback progress recorded.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Sessions/Playing/Progress
http://localhost/Sessions/Playing/Progress

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Playstate/operation/ReportPlaybackStopped)Reports playback has stopped within a session.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
The playback stop info.
Item |  object or null Gets or sets the item.
---|---
ItemId |  string <uuid> Gets or sets the item identifier.
SessionId |  string or null Gets or sets the session id.
MediaSourceId |  string or null Gets or sets the media version identifier.
PositionTicks |  integer or null <int64> Gets or sets the position ticks.
LiveStreamId |  string or null Gets or sets the live stream identifier.
PlaySessionId |  string or null Gets or sets the play session identifier.
Failed |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this MediaBrowser.Model.Session.PlaybackStopInfo is failed.
NextMediaType |  string or null
PlaylistItemId |  string or null
NowPlayingQueue |  Array of objects or null (QueueItem)
### Responses
**204**
Playback stop recorded.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Sessions/Playing/Stopped
http://localhost/Sessions/Playing/Stopped

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Search)Search
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Search/operation/GetSearchHints)Gets the search hint result.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Supply a user id to search within a user's library or omit to search all.
searchTermrequired |  string The search term to filter on.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" If specified, only results with the specified item types are returned. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" If specified, results with these item types are filtered out. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" If specified, only results with the specified media types are returned. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
parentId |  string <uuid> If specified, only children of the parent are returned.
isMovie |  boolean Optional filter for movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional filter for series.
isNews |  boolean Optional filter for news.
isKids |  boolean Optional filter for kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional filter for sports.
includePeople |  boolean Default:  true Optional filter whether to include people.
includeMedia |  boolean Default:  true Optional filter whether to include media.
includeGenres |  boolean Default:  true Optional filter whether to include genres.
includeStudios |  boolean Default:  true Optional filter whether to include studios.
includeArtists |  boolean Default:  true Optional filter whether to include artists.
### Responses
**200**
Search hint returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Studios)Studios
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Studios/operation/GetStudios)Gets all studios from a given item, folder, or the entire library.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
---|---
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
searchTerm |  string Optional. Search term.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
userId |  string <uuid> User id.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Total record count.
### Responses
**200**
Studios returned.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Subtitle/operation/SearchRemoteSubtitles)Search remote subtitles.

---|---

Forbidden

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Trailers)Trailers
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Trailers/operation/GetTrailers)Finds movies and trailers similar to a given trailer.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id supplied as query parameter; this is required when not using an API key.
---|---
maxOfficialRating |  string Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).
hasThemeSong |  boolean Optional filter by items with theme songs.
hasThemeVideo |  boolean Optional filter by items with theme videos.
hasSubtitles |  boolean Optional filter by items with subtitles.
hasSpecialFeature |  boolean Optional filter by items with special features.
hasTrailer |  boolean Optional filter by items with trailers.
adjacentTo |  string <uuid> Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.
parentIndexNumber |  integer <int32> Optional filter by parent index number.
hasParentalRating |  boolean Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.
isHd |  boolean Optional filter by items that are HD or not.
is4K |  boolean Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.
locationTypes |  Array of strings (LocationType)  Items Enum: "FileSystem" "Remote" "Virtual" "Offline" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
excludeLocationTypes |  Array of strings (LocationType)  Items Enum: "FileSystem" "Remote" "Virtual" "Offline" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
isMissing |  boolean Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.
isUnaired |  boolean Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.
minCommunityRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum community rating.
minCriticRating |  number <double> Optional filter by minimum critic rating.
minPremiereDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.
minDateLastSaved |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.
minDateLastSavedForUser |  string <date-time> Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.
maxPremiereDate |  string <date-time> Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.
hasOverview |  boolean Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.
hasImdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have an IMDb id or not.
hasTmdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have a TMDb id or not.
hasTvdbId |  boolean Optional filter by items that have a TVDb id or not.
isMovie |  boolean Optional filter for live tv movies.
isSeries |  boolean Optional filter for live tv series.
isNews |  boolean Optional filter for live tv news.
isKids |  boolean Optional filter for live tv kids.
isSports |  boolean Optional filter for live tv sports.
excludeItemIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
recursive |  boolean When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.
searchTerm |  string Optional. Filter based on a search term.
sortOrder |  Array of strings (SortOrder)  Items Enum: "Ascending" "Descending" Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.
parentId |  string <uuid> Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.
excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
filters |  Array of strings (ItemFilter)  Items Enum: "IsFolder" "IsNotFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "IsFavorite" "IsResumable" "Likes" "Dislikes" "IsFavoriteOrLikes" Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.
isFavorite |  boolean Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
imageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
isPlayed |  boolean Optional filter by items that are played, or not.
genres |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
officialRatings |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
tags |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
years |  Array of integers <int32> [ items <int32 > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional, include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
person |  string Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.
personIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.
personTypes |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.
studios |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
artists |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
excludeArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
artistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.
albumArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.
contributingArtistIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.
albums |  Array of strings Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
albumIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
ids |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
videoTypes |  Array of strings (VideoType)  Items Enum: "VideoFile" "Iso" "Dvd" "BluRay" Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.
minOfficialRating |  string Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).
isLocked |  boolean Optional filter by items that are locked.
isPlaceHolder |  boolean Optional filter by items that are placeholders.
hasOfficialRating |  boolean Optional filter by items that have official ratings.
collapseBoxSetItems |  boolean Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.
minWidth |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.
minHeight |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.
maxWidth |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.
maxHeight |  integer <int32> Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.
is3D |  boolean Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.
seriesStatus |  Array of strings (SeriesStatus)  Items Enum: "Continuing" "Ended" "Unreleased" Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
nameStartsWithOrGreater |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.
nameStartsWith |  string Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.
nameLessThan |  string Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.
studioIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
genreIds |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ] Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Enable the total record count.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional, include image information in output.
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Trickplay)Trickplay
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Trickplay/operation/GetTrickplayTileImage)Gets a trickplay tile image.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
widthrequired |  integer <int32> The width of a single tile.
indexrequired |  integer <int32> The index of the desired tile.
##### query Parameters
mediaSourceId |  string <uuid> The media version id, if using an alternate version.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Tile image not found at specified index.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Not Found
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Videos/{itemId}/Trickplay/{width}/{index}.jpg
http://localhost/Videos/{itemId}/Trickplay/{width}/{index}.jpg

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/TvShows)TvShows
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/TvShows/operation/GetEpisodes)Gets episodes for a tv season.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
seriesIdrequired |  string <uuid> The series id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
season |  integer <int32> Optional filter by season number.
seasonId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by season id.
isMissing |  boolean Optional. Filter by items that are missing episodes or not.
adjacentTo |  string <uuid> Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.
startItemId |  string <uuid> Optional. Skip through the list until a given item is found.
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
enableImages |  boolean Optional, include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
sortBy |  string Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Not Found
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/TvShows/operation/GetSeasons)Gets seasons for a tv series.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
seriesIdrequired |  string <uuid> The series id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.
isSpecialSeason |  boolean Optional. Filter by special season.
isMissing |  boolean Optional. Filter by items that are missing episodes or not.
adjacentTo |  string <uuid> Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Not Found
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Shows/{seriesId}/Seasons
http://localhost/Shows/{seriesId}/Seasons

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/TvShows/operation/GetNextUp)Gets a list of next up episodes.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id of the user to get the next up episodes for.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
seriesId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by series id.
parentId |  string <uuid> Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
nextUpDateCutoff |  string <date-time> Optional. Starting date of shows to show in Next Up section.
enableTotalRecordCount |  boolean Default:  true Whether to enable the total records count. Defaults to true.
disableFirstEpisode |  boolean Deprecated  Default:  false Whether to disable sending the first episode in a series as next up.
enableResumable |  boolean Default:  true Whether to include resumable episodes in next up results.
enableRewatching |  boolean Default:  false Whether to include watched episodes in next up results.
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Shows/NextUp
http://localhost/Shows/NextUp
