##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/TvShows/operation/GetUpcomingEpisodes)Gets a list of upcoming episodes.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id of the user to get the upcoming episodes for.
---|---
startIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.
limit |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of records to return.
fields |  Array of strings (ItemFields)  Items Enum: "AirTime" "CanDelete" "CanDownload" "ChannelInfo" "Chapters" "Trickplay" "ChildCount" "CumulativeRunTimeTicks" "CustomRating" "DateCreated" "DateLastMediaAdded" "DisplayPreferencesId" "Etag" "ExternalUrls" "Genres" "ItemCounts" "MediaSourceCount" "MediaSources" "OriginalTitle" "Overview" "ParentId" "Path" "People" "PlayAccess" "ProductionLocations" "ProviderIds" "PrimaryImageAspectRatio" "RecursiveItemCount" "Settings" "SeriesStudio" "SortName" "SpecialEpisodeNumbers" "Studios" "Taglines" "Tags" "RemoteTrailers" "MediaStreams" "SeasonUserData" "DateLastRefreshed" "DateLastSaved" "RefreshState" "ChannelImage" "EnableMediaSourceDisplay" "Width" "Height" "ExtraIds" "LocalTrailerCount" "IsHD" "SpecialFeatureCount" Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.
parentId |  string <uuid> Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.
enableImages |  boolean Optional. Include image information in output.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
### Responses
**200**
Success
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Shows/Upcoming
http://localhost/Shows/Upcoming

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/UniversalAudio)UniversalAudio
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/UniversalAudio/operation/GetUniversalAudioStream)Gets an audio stream.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
container |  Array of strings Optional. The audio container.
---|---
mediaSourceId |  string The media version id, if playing an alternate version.
deviceId |  string The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. The user id.
audioCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. The audio codec to transcode to.
maxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of audio channels.
transcodingAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. The number of how many audio channels to transcode to.
maxStreamingBitrate |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum streaming bitrate.
audioBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
startTimeTicks |  integer <int64> Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.
transcodingContainer |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. The container to transcode to.
transcodingProtocol |  string Enum: "http" "hls" Optional. The transcoding protocol.
maxAudioSampleRate |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum audio sample rate.
maxAudioBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.
enableRemoteMedia |  boolean Optional. Whether to enable remote media.
enableAudioVbrEncoding |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Whether to enable Audio Encoding.
breakOnNonKeyFrames |  boolean Default:  false Optional. Whether to break on non key frames.
enableRedirection |  boolean Default:  true Whether to enable redirection. Defaults to true.
### Responses
**200**
Audio stream returned.
**302**
Redirected to remote audio stream.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Item not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
get/Audio/{itemId}/universal
http://localhost/Audio/{itemId}/universal
###  Response samples

Content type
application/json application/json; profile="CamelCase" application/json; profile="PascalCase"application/json

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/User/operation/UpdateUser)Updates a user.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
The updated user model.
Name |  string or null Gets or sets the name.
---|---
ServerId |  string or null Gets or sets the server identifier.
ServerName |  string or null Gets or sets the name of the server. This is not used by the server and is for client-side usage only.
Id |  string <uuid> Gets or sets the id.
PrimaryImageTag |  string or null Gets or sets the primary image tag.
HasPassword |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance has password.
HasConfiguredPassword |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance has configured password.
HasConfiguredEasyPassword |  boolean Deprecated  Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance has configured easy password.
EnableAutoLogin |  boolean or null Gets or sets whether async login is enabled or not.
LastLoginDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the last login date.
LastActivityDate |  string or null <date-time> Gets or sets the last activity date.
Configuration |  object or null Gets or sets the configuration.
Policy |  object or null Gets or sets the policy.
PrimaryImageAspectRatio |  number or null <double> Gets or sets the primary image aspect ratio.
### Responses
**204**
User updated.
**400**
User information was not supplied.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
User update forbidden.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/User/operation/UpdateUserPolicy)Updates a user policy.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
userIdrequired |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
The new user policy.
IsAdministrator |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is administrator.
---|---
IsHidden |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is hidden.
EnableCollectionManagement |  boolean Default:  false Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance can manage collections.
EnableSubtitleManagement |  boolean Default:  false Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance can manage subtitles.
EnableLyricManagement |  boolean Default:  false Gets or sets a value indicating whether this user can manage lyrics.
IsDisabled |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is disabled.
MaxParentalRating |  integer or null <int32> Gets or sets the max parental rating.
MaxParentalSubRating |  integer or null <int32>
BlockedTags |  Array of strings or null
AllowedTags |  Array of strings or null
EnableUserPreferenceAccess |  boolean
AccessSchedules |  Array of objects or null (AccessSchedule)
BlockUnratedItems |  Array of strings or null (UnratedItem)  Enum: "Movie" "Trailer" "Series" "Music" "Book" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "ChannelContent" "Other"
EnableRemoteControlOfOtherUsers |  boolean
EnableSharedDeviceControl |  boolean
EnableRemoteAccess |  boolean
EnableLiveTvManagement |  boolean
EnableLiveTvAccess |  boolean
EnableMediaPlayback |  boolean
EnableAudioPlaybackTranscoding |  boolean
EnableVideoPlaybackTranscoding |  boolean
EnablePlaybackRemuxing |  boolean
ForceRemoteSourceTranscoding |  boolean
EnableContentDeletion |  boolean
EnableContentDeletionFromFolders |  Array of strings or null
EnableContentDownloading |  boolean
EnableSyncTranscoding |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether [enable synchronize].
EnableMediaConversion |  boolean
EnabledDevices |  Array of strings or null
EnableAllDevices |  boolean
EnabledChannels |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
EnableAllChannels |  boolean
EnabledFolders |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
EnableAllFolders |  boolean
InvalidLoginAttemptCount |  integer <int32>
LoginAttemptsBeforeLockout |  integer <int32>
MaxActiveSessions |  integer <int32>
EnablePublicSharing |  boolean
BlockedMediaFolders |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
BlockedChannels |  Array of strings or null <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
RemoteClientBitrateLimit |  integer <int32>
AuthenticationProviderIdrequired |  string
PasswordResetProviderIdrequired |  string
SyncPlayAccess |  string Enum: "CreateAndJoinGroups" "JoinGroups" "None" Gets or sets a value indicating what SyncPlay features the user can access.
### Responses
**204**
User policy updated.

User policy was not supplied.

Unauthorized

application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
The Jellyfin.Api.Models.UserDtos.QuickConnectDto request.
Secretrequired |  string Gets or sets the quick connect secret.

### Responses
**200**

**400**

**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/User/operation/UpdateUserConfiguration)Updates a user configuration.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
The new user configuration.
AudioLanguagePreference |  string or null Gets or sets the audio language preference.
---|---
PlayDefaultAudioTrack |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether [play default audio track].
SubtitleLanguagePreference |  string or null Gets or sets the subtitle language preference.
DisplayMissingEpisodes |  boolean
GroupedFolders |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
SubtitleMode |  string Enum: "Default" "Always" "OnlyForced" "None" "Smart" An enum representing a subtitle playback mode.
DisplayCollectionsView |  boolean
EnableLocalPassword |  boolean
OrderedViews |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
LatestItemsExcludes |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
MyMediaExcludes |  Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
HidePlayedInLatest |  boolean
RememberAudioSelections |  boolean
RememberSubtitleSelections |  boolean
EnableNextEpisodeAutoPlay |  boolean
CastReceiverId |  string or null Gets or sets the id of the selected cast receiver.
### Responses
**204**
User configuration updated.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
User configuration update forbidden.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Users/Configuration
http://localhost/Users/Configuration

Content type
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/User/operation/UpdateUserPassword)Updates a user's password.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> The user id.
---|---
##### Request Body schema:
application/json text/json application/*+jsonapplication/json
required
The M:Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.UserController.UpdateUserPassword(System.Nullable{System.Guid},Jellyfin.Api.Models.UserDtos.UpdateUserPassword) request.
CurrentPassword |  string or null Gets or sets the current sha1-hashed password.
---|---
CurrentPw |  string or null Gets or sets the current plain text password.
NewPw |  string or null Gets or sets the new plain text password.
ResetPassword |  boolean Gets or sets a value indicating whether to reset the password.
### Responses
**204**
Password successfully reset.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
User is not allowed to update the password.
**404**
User not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.
post/Users/Password
http://localhost/Users/Password

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/VideoAttachments)VideoAttachments
##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/VideoAttachments/operation/GetAttachment)Get video attachment.
##### path Parameters
videoIdrequired |  string <uuid> Video ID.
---|---
mediaSourceIdrequired |  string Media Source ID.
indexrequired |  integer <int32> Attachment Index.
### Responses
**200**
Attachment retrieved.
**404**
Video or attachment not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

http://localhost/Videos/{videoId}/{mediaSourceId}/Attachments/{index}

##### path Parameters
itemIdrequired |  string <uuid> The item id.
---|---
##### query Parameters
container |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The video container. Possible values are: ts, webm, asf, wmv, ogv, mp4, m4v, mkv, mpeg, mpg, avi, 3gp, wmv, wtv, m2ts, mov, iso, flv.
---|---
static |  boolean Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.
params |  string The streaming parameters.
tag |  string The tag.
deviceProfileId |  string Deprecated  Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.
playSessionId |  string The play session id.
segmentContainer |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ The segment container.
segmentLength |  integer <int32> The segment length.
minSegments |  integer <int32> The minimum number of segments.
mediaSourceId |  string The media version id, if playing an alternate version.
deviceId |  string The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.
audioCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.
enableAutoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.
allowVideoStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.
allowAudioStreamCopy |  boolean Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.
breakOnNonKeyFrames |  boolean Optional. Whether to break on non key frames.
audioSampleRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.
maxAudioBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.

profile |  string Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.

framerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
maxFramerate |  number <float> Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.
copyTimestamps |  boolean Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.
startTimeTicks |  integer <int64> Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.
width |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.
height |  integer <int32> Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.
maxWidth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum horizontal resolution of the encoded video.
maxHeight |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum vertical resolution of the encoded video.
videoBitRate |  integer <int32> Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.
subtitleStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.
subtitleMethod |  string Enum: "Encode" "Embed" "External" "Hls" "Drop" Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.
maxRefFrames |  integer <int32> Optional.
maxVideoBitDepth |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum video bit depth.
requireAvc |  boolean Optional. Whether to require avc.
deInterlace |  boolean Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.
requireNonAnamorphic |  boolean Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.
transcodingMaxAudioChannels |  integer <int32> Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.
cpuCoreLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.
liveStreamId |  string The live stream id.
enableMpegtsM2TsMode |  boolean Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.
videoCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.
subtitleCodec |  string^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\._,|]{0,40}$ Optional. Specify a subtitle codec to encode to.
transcodeReasons |  string Optional. The transcoding reason.
audioStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.
videoStreamIndex |  integer <int32> Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.
context |  string Enum: "Streaming" "Static" Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.
streamOptions |  object Optional. The streaming options.
enableAudioVbrEncoding |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Whether to enable Audio Encoding.

excludeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be excluded based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
includeItemTypes |  Array of strings (BaseItemKind)  Items Enum: "AggregateFolder" "Audio" "AudioBook" "BasePluginFolder" "Book" "BoxSet" "Channel" "ChannelFolderItem" "CollectionFolder" "Episode" "Folder" "Genre" "ManualPlaylistsFolder" "Movie" "LiveTvChannel" "LiveTvProgram" "MusicAlbum" "MusicArtist" "MusicGenre" "MusicVideo" "Person" "Photo" "PhotoAlbum" "Playlist" "PlaylistsFolder" "Program" "Recording" "Season" "Series" "Studio" "Trailer" "TvChannel" "TvProgram" "UserRootFolder" "UserView" "Video" "Year" Optional. If specified, results will be included based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.
mediaTypes |  Array of strings (MediaType)  Items Enum: "Unknown" "Video" "Audio" "Photo" "Book" Optional. Filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.
sortBy |  Array of strings (ItemSortBy)  Items Enum: "Default" "AiredEpisodeOrder" "Album" "AlbumArtist" "Artist" "DateCreated" "OfficialRating" "DatePlayed" "PremiereDate" "StartDate" "SortName" "Name" "Random" "Runtime" "CommunityRating" "ProductionYear" "PlayCount" "CriticRating" "IsFolder" "IsUnplayed" "IsPlayed" "SeriesSortName" "VideoBitRate" "AirTime" "Studio" "IsFavoriteOrLiked" "DateLastContentAdded" "SeriesDatePlayed" "ParentIndexNumber" "IndexNumber" Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.
enableUserData |  boolean Optional. Include user data.
imageTypeLimit |  integer <int32> Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.
enableImageTypes |  Array of strings (ImageType)  Items Enum: "Primary" "Art" "Backdrop" "Banner" "Logo" "Thumb" "Disc" "Box" "Screenshot" "Menu" "Chapter" "BoxRear" "Profile" Optional. The image types to include in the output.
userId |  string <uuid> User Id.
recursive |  boolean Default:  true Search recursively.
enableImages |  boolean Default:  true Optional. Include image information in output.

##  [](https://api.jellyfin.org/#tag/Years/operation/GetYear)Gets a year.
##### Authorizations:
_CustomAuthentication_
##### path Parameters
yearrequired |  integer <int32> The year.
---|---
##### query Parameters
userId |  string <uuid> Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
---|---
### Responses
**200**
Year returned.
**401**
Unauthorized
**403**
Forbidden
**404**
Year not found.
**503**
The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.

http://localhost/Years/{year}
